## Reviewer checklist

- [ ] CI lint passes on all three OS lanes.
- [ ] No new outbound telemetry, analytics, or phone-home code.
- [ ] No Google services / Sync / Cast / Widevine enabled by default.
- [ ] No proprietary dependencies added.
- [ ] No third-party cookie or storage default loosened.
- [ ] Documentation updated (`docs/dev/` and/or `docs/user/`).
- [ ] If a Chromium patch was added, it's also exported via `scripts/refresh-patches.py`.
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits.
